bank.retain_mission: Extract undocumented third-party library quirks, version breaking changes, API workarounds, and verified framework best practices. Ignore standard API reference manuals, raw docs pages, and transient search engine results (which context7 and websearch fetch live).
bank.observations_mission: Track third-party dependency version gotchas, API breaking changes, library workarounds, and framework best practices over time.
bank.reflect_mission: Synthesize a documentation briefing focusing on undocumented library quirks, version workarounds, and verified framework best practices.

mental_models.name: Undocumented Library Quirks & Workarounds
mental_models.source_query: What third-party library bugs, version incompatibilities, undocumented behaviors, or API workarounds were discovered?

mental_models.name: Verified Framework Best Practices
mental_models.source_query: What verified framework best practices, integration patterns, and configuration rules were validated for our tech stack?
